episodeTitle.en: 4 questions Shreyas wishes he’d asked himself sooner | Former PM leader at Stripe, Twitter, Google
episodeTitle.zh: 施雷亚斯希望自己能早点问自己的4个问题 | 曾任Stripe、Twitter、Google产品经理的领导者

guestBioOfficial.en: Shreyas Doshi is a former product leader at Stripe, Twitter, Google, and Yahoo. He’s now a full-time advisor and coach to founders and executives. Shreyas is known for his incredibly insightful writing on products, which has garnered him a passionate following in the PM and startup community. Last week, we sat down together at the very first Lenny and Friends Summit in San Francisco for a special live episode. We covered: • Why product leaders often feel overwhelmed with work, and how to combat it
guestBioOfficial.zh: 施雷亚斯·多希曾是Stripe、Twitter、Google和雅虎的产品负责人。如今，他全职为创始人和高管提供顾问及指导服务。施雷亚斯以其对产品领域极具洞察力的文章而闻名，在产品管理和创业社区收获了热情追随者。上周，我们在旧金山首届Lenny和朋友们峰会上进行了特别的现场访谈，内容包括：• 产品负责人为何常感工作负担过重，以及如何应对这一挑战

title.en: 4 questions Shreyas wishes he’d asked himself sooner | Former PM leader at Stripe, Twitter, Google
title.zh: 施雷亚斯希望自己能早点问自己的4个问题 | 曾任Stripe、Twitter、Google产品经理的领导者

summary.en: Shreyas shares his philosophy of high-leverage product work, including the art of saying no, focusing on outcomes over output, and protecting cognitive bandwidth for the few things that matter. He discusses how to develop product taste, the discipline of ignoring most requests, and why great PMs think in terms of leverage and systems. The episode is a dense, actionable masterclass in the craft of product management.
summary.zh: Shreyas 分享了他关于高杠杆产品工作的理念，包括说“不”的艺术、聚焦产出之上的成果、以及为少数要事保护认知带宽。他讨论了如何培养产品品味、忽略大多数请求的自律，以及为什么优秀的产品经理以杠杆与系统的方式思考。本期是关于产品管理手艺的、信息密集且可落地的导师课。
